_comment: Reactions for the kana quiz and the grammar drills. Images and texts are paired in order: the first image always says the first line, the second the second, and so on — a gif and its caption are one joke. Give one line and every image says it; give more lines than images and the extras become alternatives for the image they land on, one picked at random. An image is a filename in this folder or a full https:// URL — gif, animated webp, avif, png or jpeg, any size: it is shown in a box of its own, and each deploy squeezes its own copy of it. Changes deploy with the next push.
